correctness.rationale: The three-tupling is a graph because all source faces have at most six vertices and every triple is a face by 3-neighborliness. Applying Gale evenness to every proper six-subset identifies each facet with the unique three-edge matching of C_n; no facet or induced graph edge is double counted. H_8 has exactly two parity-class connected components on 8 and 48 triple vertices. For H_q→H_(q+1), a new triple containing q is incident to a matching with terminal edge (q−1,q) and two disjoint covering path edges; the complementary triple is old and remains in its parity component. For even cycle length, every matching balances parity and cannot join these components; for odd n≥9, the wrap matching {(n−1,0),(1,2),(3,4)} explicitly joins them. The n=7 base is connected. Every facet supplies ten complementary-triple graph edges, so E=10F with F=n(n−4)(n−5)/6; each connected graph has wedge rank E−V+1, giving the exact claimed formulas. Independently enumerated Gale facets, matching facets, component edge/vertex counts for n=7..12; this is corroboration, not the proof for all n. The path covering lemma and induction establish the infinite range.
